purpose: Teach: 安売り/値動き/外装/試用/贈呈/発案/損得/取り立て

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究費を安売りで節約するな
lines.en: Ren — don't try to cut corners on the research budget.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Slight weight on the prohibition. Not harsh, but the tone of someone who has seen shortcuts before and won't tolerate them. Clear-eyed authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の引用数の値動きを記録しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm tracking the citation trajectory of the papers.
lines.style: Careful, slightly formal. Ren wants to show he understands the depth of what was asked. Small pause before the second sentence — he's thinking, not just repeating. Respectful but not fawning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の外装、つまり表紙にもこだわれ
lines.en: Ren — pay attention to the paper's presentation too. The cover matters.
lines.style: Instructional, almost gentle. The tone of someone offering a principle, not a rebuke. Slight emphasis on 「外装」 — he's expanding Ren's thinking. Warm underneath the direction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。試薬の試用結果を学会で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. We presented the reagent trials at the conference.
lines.style: Formal, measured. Ren is reporting back — showing he's applied the feedback. Steady pace. No rush. The tone of a student who listens and acts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究者への贈呈品を準備しろ
lines.en: Ren — prepare gifts for your collaborators.
lines.style: Brief, expectant. Direct instruction without elaboration. The confidence of someone who knows Ren will understand why this matters. Tone: professional, slightly warmer than the first line.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマは指導教授の発案でした
lines.en: Yes. The research direction came from my advisor's suggestion.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Ren is crediting his mentor — showing humility and clarity about intellectual lineage. Calm, precise. Not defensive, just factual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究では損得抜きで真実を追求しろ
lines.en: Ren — in research, pursue the truth without calculating gain or loss.
lines.style: Solemn and principled. This is the heart of the lesson — spoken with quiet conviction. Slight emphasis on 「真実」. The pace slows. The tone of someone passing down something that matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の取り立てではなく支援を申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll apply for research support, not for collection purposes.
lines.style: Resolved and clear-eyed. Ren understands the ethical distinction now. Slight lift at the end — he's not just obeying, he's committed. Warm undertone of gratitude for the guidance.
